sections.projects:
AGENTX – AUTONOMOUS BROWSER AI AGENT​
Link
●​
Built an autonomous browser agent that converts natural language goals into executable task plans, enabling
end-to-end web automation with planning, execution, verification, and self-correction.
●​
Engineered a modular agent architecture comprising an LLM-based planner, asynchronous execution engine,
Playwright browser controller, verification pipeline, and SQLite-backed memory for reusable execution
knowledge.
●​
Implemented adaptive failure recovery using retry, selector repair, and dynamic replanning strategies, allowing
the agent to recover from DOM changes, navigation failures, and execution errors autonomously.
●​
Designed a benchmark suite spanning 25 browser automation tasks across navigation, extraction, form
interaction, multi-step reasoning, and error recovery, achieving 88% overall task completion while averaging
15.9 s/task and 2.2 execution steps/task.
●​
Stack: Python · FastAPI · Playwright · SQLite · LLMs · AsyncIO · REST APIs
AUTHX – MULTI-LAYER CONTENT AUTHENTICATION & THEFT DETECTION SYSTEM ​
Link
●​
Developed a content authentication framework to detect image manipulation, AI-generated alterations, and
partial-copy theft using perceptual hashing, frequency-domain analysis, and metadata verification.
●​
Achieved 97% detection accuracy on a curated evaluation dataset by combining pHash similarity scoring,
DCT/FFT-based signal analysis, and adaptive thresholding while maintaining zero observed false positives.
●​
Designed a multi-stage verification pipeline integrating SHA-256 integrity checks, perceptual similarity
matching, and forensic pattern analysis.
●​
Research accepted for presentation at the ICCSP 2026 peer-reviewed international conference.
●​
Stack: Python · SHA-256 · pHash · DCT/FFT Signal Processing · Pattern Analysis
